difficulty: The output is right on the author's UTC machine and wrong for anyone east of it, so the fix is to switch dayKey from local getters to their UTC equivalents.
prompt: Users in UTC+10 report that dayKey() in src/day.js puts their late-evening timestamps on the wrong calendar day. It should key by the UTC date instead of the local one. Fix it.
reference: Uses getUTCFullYear/getUTCMonth/getUTCDate so the day key no longer depends on the machine's timezone.
